_description: Published 2026 B2B SaaS retention benchmarks used to CALIBRATE the synthetic load-driver so generated books are statistically defensible ('our SMB cohort runs 97% NRR, matching ChartMogul') even though the rows are generated. This anchors the SYNTHETIC BEHAVIOR layer (health, lifecycle events, NRR/churn) to real-world distributions. It does NOT make any single account's outcome/counterfactual real — that layer (what CS Pulse 'would have saved') is inherently model-generated and is NOT sourced here. See README_real_data.md.
_honest_claim: Real-anchored hybrid. Defensible: 'behavior calibrated to 2026 SaaS benchmarks'. NOT defensible: 'real customer outcome data'.
_nrr_identity: For each segment: nrr_median == 1 + expansion_rate - contraction_rate - gross_revenue_churn_annual (revenue-weighted, annual). The generator reproduces this in aggregate via discrete per-account lifecycle events.

sources.label: Optifai Pipeline Study 2026 (N=939 B2B SaaS, cross-referenced vs public 10-Ks + ChartMogul N=2,100)
Net Revenue Retention Benchmarks 2026 (SaaS expansion data)
SaaS Churn Rate Benchmarks 2026 (500+ companies; ~3.5% monthly median blended, higher for SMB)

portfolio_defaults._note: Default share of ACCOUNTS by segment for a typical B2B book (skews mid-market). The generator re-weights NRR by ARR, so enterprise/mid dominate the blended portfolio NRR.
portfolio_defaults.blended_nrr_expected_note: ARR-weighted blended NRR for the default mix + segment ARR bands below; recomputed exactly by the generator per generated book.

lifecycle_magnitudes._note: Per-event delta_pct ranges the generator samples from, then scales so each segment's aggregate expansion/contraction $ hits the rate above.

story_arc_by_role._note: Maps a generated account's calibrated ROLE to a real story_arc vocabulary value (verified against existing SaaS manifests). Used for narrative realism; does not affect NRR arithmetic.
